pages.text: Cables carry power and fluids between your machines (to move items, use a drone with a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport Module$(/l)). Every kind $(l)connects by itself$() to cables of the same kind and to any block that accepts what it carries, from CyberFarm or any

other mod. Each kind comes in $(l)three tiers$(), told apart by the ring where two cables meet: grey, $(l)gold$() and $(l)violet$().$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Advanced Energy Conduit$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Elite Energy Conduit$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Advanced Gas Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Elite Gas Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Advanced Liquid Pipe$(/l)

$(li)$(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Elite Liquid Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l): FE, 2,000 FE/t, 16,000 FE/t, 128,000 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l): gases: biogas, methane, Steam, 1,000 mB/t, 4,000 mB/t, 16,000 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l): liquids: water, lava, coolants, acid, 1,000 mB/t, 4,000 mB/t, 16,000 mB/t

The rate is how much can enter the network $(l)from each source$(): a generator or tank pushing in. It is set by the pipe the source touches, so tiers can be mixed in one network: put a better pipe right where a big producer connects.

As a guide, the numbers sit between Immersive Engineering's wires and Mekanism's cables:$(br)$(li)$(l)Basic$() carries all the gas power and a Small Steam Turbine (800 FE/t).$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced$() carries a Large Steam Turbine (9,600 FE/t) or the steam of a Large reactor (2,400 mB/t).

$(li)$(l)Elite$() joins several turbines into one line.$(br)Cables $(l)store nothing$(): whatever comes in goes straight to the blocks on the other end. A network can be up to 1,024 cables long. Different kinds never connect to each other, so they can run side by side.

Generators and machines push what they make into the cables by themselves. Batteries, tanks and other storage do not: to take something $(l)out$() of them, $(l)right-click the cable's arm$() that touches the block. An orange collar appears and the cable $(l)pulls$() from that block every tick, up to its tier's rate.
pages.title: Pulling out of a block

pages.text: Right-click it again to stop.$(br2)The network never sends anything back into a block it pulls from, so a pulling arm is a one-way exit. Use it to empty a $(l:cables/fluid_tanks)Liquid Tank or Gas Tank$(/l), or a battery of another mod.
$(l)Upgrading$(): 8 cables around gold and redstone make 8 Advanced ones; 8 Advanced around diamonds and a uranium ingot make 8 Elite ones.
